summary: XJO fell -1.51% to 8,744.4 — biggest single-session fall in 7 weeks. Hormuz ceasefire doubts (Tehran: reopening plan 'unrealistic') reversed peace-deal optimism. RBA hiked to 4.35% on 05/05 (8-1 vote, third consecutive hike). Financials -2.25%, REITs -2.23% worst sectors. SKS +6.49% on $22m contract and $1.25bn tender pipeline. Week still up ~0.5% — first positive week in a month. Smart Money: Advertising & Marketing #1 for second consecutive week (ROC +12.83%).
